_doc: The three capstone deeds of the Standing ladder (victory-gating redesign, Steve 2026-11-07: 'Yes build it and test it.'). One of the three, delivered at National stage with the realm behind the village and the wave deeds done, opens the Galactic Seat. The feast embassy is grounded in existing deeds; the trade charter reads the existing Charter national beat; the military tribute has NO existing deed at base a04a6c0fc and is defined here, in data, per brief (f) Q6 — not in code. Read by src/js/ladder.js ladderCapstones() (with an in-code mirror as fallback until game.js's init list loads this file — leg 2's surgery). The delivery itself (recording on progState().ladderCapstone, paying the price) is leg 2's seat surgery; ladder.js only READS readiness.

capstones._tuning: 2 veterans mirrors the wave-5 readiness demand (standing.js readyDemand veterans: 2) — a real price, achievable (the r152 panel banked 3 living veterans on one seed). Panel-calibrated; the leg-4 panel may move it.
capstones.label: Military tribute
capstones.payment: Two living wave-4 veterans leave Haven in the table's service (recorded on progState().ladderCapstone; the roster removal is the seat surgery, leg 2).
capstones.source: NEW — no existing military-tribute deed exists at base a04a6c0fc (no deed in src/data or src/js pays fighters in blood to the table; the nearest tribute, table.js demandprice:tribute, is a 12,000 kcal failure price, not a military deed). Defined here in data, per brief (f) Q6.

capstones.label: Trade charter
capstones.payment: A sealed charter with a national-scale polity (a trade link with chartered=true).
capstones.source: EXISTING — hierarchy.js Charter national beat (stageNationalBeat/resolve: trade league of >=3 bonds, sign/bargain sets link.chartered=true, tariffRate 1000/1500).

capstones.label: Feast embassy
capstones.payment: The feast bundle completed while at National stage.
capstones.source: GROUNDED — feast-log bundle flag + National stage; the bundle flag itself is leg 2's write (game.js feastPlan/hostFeast).
